name: tripplanner-artifact
description: Build and test tooling for dist/trip-planner.html. The artifact has NO dependencies: `node build.js` needs nothing installed, and nothing here is ever bundled into it (PATTERN.md §5.11).
comment: `ajv` is the reference implementation the hand-written JSON Schema subset is cross-checked against (REQ-806, ADR-0008). It is a DEV dependency on purpose and stays one: REQ-807 forbids a runtime validator dependency, because the artifact has to validate offline and a second policy origin inside a file whose premise is that it has one is exactly what ADR-0008 rejected. The cross-check in test/schema-crosscheck.test.js declares its own reason and skips when this is absent, so a bare checkout still runs the whole suite.
